summary: Retested the iteration_10 restore bug and its related changes at 375x667 as user test-backup. FIXED: when Pulihkan is tapped, PUT /api/data (200 at +72ms) now completes before PUT /api/profile starts (200 at +133ms), and the toast 'Data berhasil dipulihkan' appears at +193ms. Reloading as soon as the toast appeared left GET /api/data EXACTLY equal to the backup (all 8 keys) and the profil restored, so the partial restore is gone. Failure path, tested with PUT /api/data blocked by page.route returning 500 and also aborted: the toast 'Gagal memulihkan data — periksa koneksi lalu coba lagi' shows, no success toast, backup-konfirmasi stays open, the server stays unchanged (0 belanja, profil 'X'), and PUT /api/profile is not sent. Retrying after the failure restores exactly. Web download: backup-simpan downloads Backup_Folio_2026-11-01.json with {app, version, dibuat, data(8 keys), profil} equal to the server, and no anchor is left in the DOM. The header reads 'Backup' with the subtitle 'Backup data & ekspor Everpro'. Reminder regression: shown when no key is set, hidden at 2 days, shown at 9 days with 'Backup terakhir 9 hari lalu.' New minor bug in toast.tsx: if a new toast is shown while the previous toast is fading out (about 2.0-2.2s after it), the new toast is hidden at once. Reproduced deterministically: after a failed restore, tapping Pulihkan again 1950ms later restored the data, but the success toast never appeared.

ui_bugs.issue: When show() is called during the 220ms fade-out of the previous toast, Animated.timing(toValue:1) stops the fade-out. The stopped animation still runs its start() callback, which calls setMsg(null) without checking `finished`, so the new message is wiped immediately. Repro: fail a restore, wait about 1.95s, then tap Pulihkan again. The data is restored, but 'Data berhasil dipulihkan' is never shown. This affects every toast in the app, not only backup.

action_items: toast.tsx: change the fade-out callback to `.start(({ finished }) => { if (finished) setMsg(null); })` and call op.stopAnimation() before fading in, so a new toast shown during the fade-out is not cleared.
critical_code_review_comments: store restore(): it clears the pending debounce timer but leaves dirty=true until the PUT succeeds. If the restore PUT fails, any unsaved local edits made just before the restore are not re-scheduled until the next state change. This is an edge case, and acceptable because the user is about to replace the data anyway.
backup-card pulihkan(): if PUT /api/data succeeds but PUT /api/profile fails, the data is restored but the toast says the restore failed. A retry is idempotent, so this is fine.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested retests passed (restore save ordering, reload exactness, 500/abort failure path, retry, download, header, reminder). One new low-priority toast race found.
